description: Community-hosted JARVIS app recordings; not an authenticated studio release.
transcription: Whisper small and base agreement <=15% normalized word edit distance; obvious uncertain lines excluded; voice-encoder cosine >=0.75 against independent reference.
processing: Phrase-only filtering, decoded-PCM SHA256 deduplication, edge silence trim with 100/150 ms padding; no internal gap cuts; highpass65Hz/lowpass10500Hz; -23LUFS/-3dBTP; mono24kHz PCM16.
hashNote: sourceSha256 in the training manifest hashes decoded float32 PCM, not the source container bytes.
fineTune: Actual rank8/alpha16 LoRA adapters on GPT2 Conv1D attention and MLP projections. Base transformer, tokenizer, voice encoder and acoustic decoder frozen. Speech next-token loss matches inference layout, no text vocabulary changes.
referencePrompt: Independent utterance; never target-audio prompt leakage.
evaluation: Same reference, seeds, texts and generation settings for base and adapted. Automated metrics do not establish human-perceived naturalness.
evaluationNote: Experimental voice adapter: 59 training / 9 validation clips. No guarantee of exact speaker likeness. Original-pitch warm equalization; no pitch shifting.

distributionPermission.scope: Project owner confirmed permission to redistribute the JARVIS recording and voice trained from it as part of Liminal, including the bundled reference and adapter.
distributionPermission.likenessRights: Covered by the project owner attestation; not independently verified.
